title: Athens Airport to central Athens — metro and bus guide (third party)
claims: Athens Airport Metro Line 3 connects the airport to Syntagma Square in roughly 40–45 minutes, with a €9 one-way ticket and trains about every 36 minutes.
Express bus X95 runs from the airport to Syntagma in about 60–70 minutes for €5.50, every 15–30 minutes.
This is a third-party airport guide, not the official Athens International Airport site; fares and timetables must be rechecked before travel.
